title: The End of the Calf and the Silent Day

paragraphs.text: The Samiri said he saw what others did not. He took a handful of dust from the track of the messenger and threw it, because his soul tempted him. Moses told him to go away. All his life he would say, "No touching," and he had a meeting in the Hereafter he could not miss. Moses said they would burn the calf and scatter it in the sea. Your only deity is Allah, who knows all things.

Allah tells the Prophet news of the past and has given him the Qur'an. Whoever turns away from it will carry a heavy load on the Day of Resurrection. When the Horn is blown, the criminals will be gathered blue-eyed. They will whisper that they stayed only ten days in the world. The best of them will say only one day.

People ask about the mountains. Allah will blow them away and leave the earth a flat plain, with no low or high places. Everyone will follow the Caller, and all voices will be quiet before the Most Merciful. No one can speak for others except with His permission. Allah knows what is before and after them. All faces will be humble before the Ever-Living. Whoever carries wrongdoing will fail, but a believer who does good will not fear injustice.

made someone want to do wrong
